text: Fixed. In `middleware/proxy.go` the balancers indexed an empty target list: `randomBalancer.Next` panicked with "invalid argument to Intn" and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` panicked with a divide-by-zero (both when a balancer has no targets, e.g. `NewRandomBalancer(nil)`). Both `Next` methods now return `nil` for an empty target list, and `ProxyWithConfig` returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) when no target is available, so a request is answered instead of crashing the server. `go test ./...` passes, including all pre-existing proxy tests.
Done — I had not yet made any edit for request #4, so `bind.go` is untouched (verified with `git status`: only `context.go` and `middleware/proxy.go` are modified). Nothing to undo.

Fixed in `context.go`. `Context#Scheme()` returned the raw value of any `X-Forwarded-Proto` / `X-Forwarded-Protocol` / `X-Url-Scheme` header, so a bogus value (e.g. `invalid`) was reported as the scheme. Now each header is only used when it actually holds a valid HTTP scheme (`http`/`https`, case-insensitive); otherwise the check falls through to the next header and finally to `http`. `go test ./...` passes, including the pre-existing `TestContext_Scheme`.
